==Description==
The '''Nuke''' is a {{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} [[Consumables|consumable]]. Upon use, the '''Nuke''' will deal massive amounts of damage to enemies and create nuclear fallout on the map which deals further damage to enemies.

Only one '''Nuke''' can be used in a match by a single player.

==Usage==
When using the '''Nuke''', your avatar's right hand will hold a radio, playing a custom idle animation. You will be able to choose an area where the '''Nuke''' will be dropped. This bomb after 2 seconds creates an explosion that deals 75,000 damage on the impact point, with damage decreasing progressively from the center outward within a large radius. The explosion does not ignore defense but it can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. Additionally, it creates nuclear fallout on the map, which damages enemies by 5% of their health every second for 25 seconds. Enemies with lower health, like the [[Abnormal]], are damaged by a higher amount, but no enemy is killed in one tick. Enemies with the [[Boss]] attribute cannot be damaged by the nuclear fallout, but are damaged by the explosion caused by the '''Nuke'''.

==Appearance==
The '''Nuke''' is a large, golden nuclear bomb. 

==Strategy==
*The '''Nuke''' can be helpful on the final wave, killing most or all of the enemies that spawn allowing your towers to focus solely on the boss.
**The '''Nuke''' should not be used before the final wave as you can only use one per match. If you are struggling, you should use other consumables instead.

==Trivia==
*The '''Nuke''' has a similar appearance to [[wp:Fat Man|Fat Man]] (also known as Mark III), a nuclear fission gravity bomb that was used during World War II.
*The '''Nuke''' is the first {{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} consumable in the game, with the second being the [[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]].
**The {{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} rarity has its text colored yellow, unlike the typical purple {{Color|Legendary}} rarity.
*The audio when calling in a '''Nuke''' says: "Bringing in the mother of all bombs!"
